content:
Maya: quick FYI — we're seeing a persistent cost delta for traces that hit late-enrich; cohort totals diverge after enrichment windows :eyes:
Kevin: can you paste the aggregation/query?
Maya: simple: select cohort_id, sum(cost) from traces where ingested_at >= now() - interval '7 days' group by cohort_id — delta only shows when tenant-lookup runs post-ingest.
Sam: classic billing-key-late problem. currently we fallback to 'unknown' and run a patcher later, right?
Maya: yes. patcher fixes ~70%, ~30% remains unknown. finance noticed big tenants in unknown bucket.
Irene: finance flagged chargeback mismatches for several large customers. they want near-real-time fidelity.
Kevin: root cause looks like unstable join keys at the edge — sometimes only session_id is present, and session->account mapping ages out so late-lookup fails.
Sam: proposal: emit a provisional_billing_key at edge when any hint exists, include provenance + TTL. Realtime dashboards can use a low-card provisional cohort; final billing uses reconciled final_billing_key after patching. Tradeoffs: added cardinality, some provisional misassigns, increased index size.
Irene: cardinality is the main worry. Could we emit provisional_cohort (low-card) instead of full tenant ids? Finance still needs final ids for chargeback.
Kevin: two-tier approach: provisional_cohort (realtime) + final_billing_id (nullable). Realtime queries use cohort; billing/chargeback uses final id after reconciliation. Reduces realtime index churn.
Sam: complexity: query layer needs a join helper to map provisional->final for historical queries, and we need an immutable reconciliation log for deterministic backfills.
Maya: minimal envelope sketch (as text): trace_id, provisional_billing_key, provisional_ttl, final_billing_key=null, billing_provenance. ~12-40 bytes/envelope.
Irene: can we avoid per-envelope fields by emitting a separate provisional-key event keyed by trace_id? Storage engines dislike extra fields.
Sam: separate event reduces envelope size but complicates ordering. aggregation may see trace before provisional event arrives; we'd need to defer attribution or require ordering.
Kevin: weak-consistency model: aggregation marks soft-missing and defers finalization for Xs; we already have deferred finalization in other flows.
Maya: ops/ingest: canary this behind flag 'experiment/prov-billing' on 2% traffic? @ingest-bot how's rollout?
ingest-bot: canary path available; can inject provisional key for 2% edge traffic. backfill workers can be throttled.
Sam: test plan: 1) RFC for schema + reconciliation contract 2) infra canary 2% 3) daily reconcile for canary cohort 4) validate finance reports vs gold.
Kevin: perf/cost: index size up ~1.5% for canary. reconcile job cost small.
Irene: finance acceptance: discrepancy <0.1% and no tenant sees undercharge >24h.
Maya: action items: Sam -> write RFC; Kevin -> prototype join helper; Maya -> run canary once flags ready. Timeline: RFC by next Wed, canary ~2 weeks.
Sam: will open RFC and link here.
Kevin: +1. add a brief failure-modes explainer for SRE.
Irene: :thumbsup:
Maya: tagging product ops/finance; will link RFC when posted.
